scope:
HAL20 consolidated candidates with opt-in exact-artifact guard. No private dependencies published.
Engine/controller boundaries are modeled; not gameplay Windows certification.

checks.name: native-MainRunDuel-admission-fence

checks.name: admission-matches-request

checks.name: candidate-load-init

checks.name: relocated-core-probe

checks.details: Inspect every active draw wrapper, actual callback symbol/full file hash and predecessor links.

checks.name: executed-dual-resolver

checks.name: handoff-invalid-flow-refused-before-consumption
